## VIC constituent redistribution: the solved mass change as face transfers, moved donor-upwind (`vic_constituent_column`) {#sec-ch07-vic-redistribute}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Turns the solved change of total density into mass transfers through the faces of the column,
then moves dry gas, each species and the passive scalars through those faces from the upwind cell, never more
than the donor holds.
**Switch.** None; always on with the VIC.
**Order.** Conservative; donor-upwind, first order in the composition.
**Defining equation.** @eq-ch07-vic-faces.
:::

The implicit system knows only the total density (@sec-ch07-vic-sweep). Applying its correction to each species
in proportion to the cell's own mass fraction would not conserve a species over the column when the mass
fractions vary with height. It also could not carry a composition contrast. So the correction is converted into
the unique set of face transfers that produces it, and the constituents ride on those transfers.

### Derivation

Let $\phi_i = (\delta_{i,0} - \Delta\rho^{\mathrm{ex}}_i)V_i$ be the mass the solve adds to cell $i$ beyond the
explicit increment, with $\delta_{i,0}$ the first entry of the solved increment. Let $m_i = \rho_iV_i$, and let
$R = \sum_i\phi_i$ be the part with no closed-face representation. The face transfers, positive upward, are

$$
M_{-1/2} = 0 , \quad M_{i+1/2} = M_{i-1/2} - \Big(\phi_i - R\,\frac{m_i}{\sum_k m_k}\Big) ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-faces}

and they telescope: $M$ at the top face is zero up to round-off, $10^{-15}$ of the largest transfer in the check
[check `src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_redist_check.py`, output `vic_redist_check.out`, `[C1]`]. Each constituent
then moves $M_{i+1/2}$ times the mass fraction of the donor cell. The donor is cell $i$ for $M>0$ and cell $i+1$
for $M<0$. A transfer is clamped to what the donor holds after its explicit update and the transfers already
made. Every transfer is taken from one cell and given to the other. So dry gas and each species keep their
column total to $2\times10^{-16}$ (`[C2]`).

Without a clamp, each cell's total change is $M_{i-1/2}-M_{i+1/2}$, which is the bracket
of @eq-ch07-vic-faces (`[C3]`). The host measures how far the clamps moved the result from that identity, as the
"clamp residual". A face that asks for more than the donor holds empties the dry donor to round-off. The species
keep a margin of 4096 ulp, the dry clamp mark is set, and the residual shows the clamp (`[C4]`, `[C5]`).

In the code, @eq-ch07-vic-faces is the prefix sum into `MASS` ([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:95-101`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L95-L101)).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-vic-redistribute for one column of the check.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-vic-redistribute
#| fig-cap: "One column of the check. Left: the cell mass changes $\\phi_i$ (sky blue) and the face transfers $M_{i-1/2}$ (orange) built from them by @eq-ch07-vic-faces, zero at the bottom and the top. Right: the resulting dry-gas (green) and species (purple, magnified 20 times) changes of each layer, moved donor-upwind."
#| fig-alt: "Two horizontal bar charts against layer number: on the left cell bars with a zig-zag line of face transfers starting and ending at zero; on the right paired green and purple bars."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch07.fig_vic_redist import make_fig
make_fig()
```

Pass 1 forms $\phi_i$, $R$ and $\sum m$, through `explicit_total` ([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:82-93`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L82-L93)).
Pass 2 is the prefix sum of @eq-ch07-vic-faces into `MASS` ([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:95-101`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L95-L101)).
Pass 3a moves the dry gas with the dry fraction of the donor, carrying `dryfrac` upward
([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:104-132`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L104-L132)). Where it clamps, it sets the mark that becomes the VIC clamp
cause of @sec-ch07-redo. Pass 3b moves each species, keeping `keep` $= 1 - 4096\epsilon$ of the donor's
species density ([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:134-160`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L134-L160)). `vic_redistribute_cell` then writes the
final tendencies: density plus the dry increment, the momenta and energy from $\delta$, and the species
increments ([`vic_redistribute_impl.h:165-185`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h#L165-L185)).

The CPU dispatch splits each column at solid cells and redistributes each fluid segment on its own, through
`vic_constituent_column` ([`implicit_dispatch.cpp:199-214`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp#L199-L214)). On CUDA the column passes are one
thread per column and the cell update one thread per cell. The host checks the clamp residual cell by cell into
`_clamp_residual` ([`implicit_hydro.cpp:358-378`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L358-L378)). The passive scalars, which are per dry mass,
move with the clamped dry-gas transfer from their donor cell, through `mass_corr`
([`meshblock.cpp:663-676`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L663-L676)).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The constituents move donor-upwind, so a composition contrast is carried at first order and smeared. A clamp
breaks the link between the solved total and the cell totals; the clamp residual reports it and the dry clamp
mark asks for a redo.
:::

1. **Dry gas has no margin.** A drained dry donor can end at $-1$ ulp; the species keep 4096 ulp (`[C4]`).
2. **Residual share.** $R$ is spread by cell mass, which puts most of it in the dense lower layers.
3. **Whole column on one rank.** The prefix sum assumes the column starts at a closed bottom on this rank
   (@sec-ch07-vic-options).
